doc: An opening on a shape's side (design/terrain.md): where a road enters or leaves, or where water flows in or out.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: The side it is on (0: from corner 0 to corner 1).

fields.name: at
fields.doc: How far along the side, 0 at its first corner to 1 at its next.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Its name, for the game (an exit's destination, say).
